svg.text: A dot right of the centre line is faster than GnuCOBOL, left is slower. Log axis, so 2x and 0.5x sit equally far out.

svg.text: gcobol is 71.7x faster than GnuCOBOL on SQRT/SIN/EXP and 12.8x faster than YACCC: it calls the hardware libm, YACCC computes in 640-bit software fixed point.
